actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen is dominating the news cycle following a court ruling that allows her to run for the French presidency in 2027 despite her conviction for misuse of EU funds. Her candidacy announcement and the subsequent political reactions have sparked intense debate across France and Europe, with her party, the National Rally, positioning itself as a major contender in the upcoming elections.
